scenario: A recruiter opens a synthetic contact, reviews authored orientation, current structured contact hints and relationship Memory, then enters the Agent-assisted create-contact flow.
frozen_evidence: web Vitest 51 files and 286 tests passed; backend Vitest 27 files and 203 tests passed; lint, docs check, typecheck, and production build passed

review_plan.reason: The contact directory, detail record, Memory, and create-contact path are core recruiter workflow surfaces.
The feature projects identity hints, authored profile content, governed sources, authorization state, and Memory.
The implementation includes a responsive contact record and mobile Agent behavior.

reviews.lens: time-constrained recruiter contact retrieval, creation, relationship continuity, and next-action clarity

findings.observation: The create-contact Agent card captures a name, one optional identity clue, one relationship context, and one source, while richer optional structured fields can only be represented later through existing evidence or profile infrastructure.
findings.evidence: screenshots/create-contact-desktop.png; browser DOM for /workspace?surface=desk&intent=create-contact; AgentCreatePersonCard fields observed in the frozen artifact
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can establish the relationship safely, but may need a second pass to add role, organization, location, additional channels, or a concise authored orientation.
findings.recommendation: Add a schema-driven optional enrichment step after identity resolution, defaulting empty fields to hidden and keeping user-authored orientation separate from sourced claims.
findings.verification: Create a synthetic contact with two channels and optional role/location fields; confirm identity checking still precedes persistence, empty fields stay hidden, and the completed record is usable without reopening a separate admin surface.

strengths: The directory presents contacts, authored orientation, relationship contexts, and recent activity in one scannable table.
The Agent create path is isolated from any existing person and explicitly says that identity checking and recruiter confirmation precede storage.
The detail page puts current dependency, structured contact hints, and relationship Memory ahead of generic biography volume.
missing_evidence: Timed task-completion evidence from independent recruiters managing a real multi-role desk.
Longitudinal evidence that the Memory grouping reduces missed follow-up without increasing stale-data maintenance.
open_questions: Which optional structured fields recur often enough across independent recruiters to deserve first-class UI rather than custom attributes?

reviews.lens: identity, provenance, authorization, privacy, freshness, state separation, and external-action authority

findings.observation: Each displayed contact point carries a source resource identifier and source label, but the current section-level View Source action opens the general source-review surface rather than targeting that exact source row.
findings.evidence: apps/backend/src/modules/people.ts contact_points projection; packages/contracts/src/resourceSchemas.ts RelationshipContactPointSchema; screenshots/contact-desktop.png
findings.user_impact: With several contact channels, a recruiter can see provenance exists but may spend extra effort locating the exact supporting source before trusting or correcting one field.
findings.recommendation: Make each contact point's provenance label a direct, scoped source-review action using source_resource_id, without revealing raw identity values in navigation or logs.
findings.verification: Open a person with three current contact points from different authorized resources; each provenance action must open only the matching governed resource and preserve masked display values.

strengths: User-authored profile text is visibly labeled as authored orientation and explicitly not evidence.
The backend projects only confirmed, unexpired contact hints with a non-deleted source and active source authorization; raw identity values are never returned.
Memory preserves proposed, contested, and confirmed status instead of promoting interpretation to confirmed person state.
The Agent create flow requires account-scoped identity checking and explicit recruiter confirmation; it states that it will not merge or contact anyone.
missing_evidence: A runtime revocation test proving an already open contact page removes a contact hint after source authorization is revoked.
A deletion and recovery test covering a contact point whose only governed source is deleted while the page is open.
open_questions: Should manually entered contact points use a distinct user-authored provenance object rather than the governed-source path?

reviews.lens: responsive task completion, visual hierarchy, touch ergonomics, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: At the 390 by 844 viewport, the fixed bottom navigation can cover the first lines of the next Memory section at an intermediate scroll position even though the page has no horizontal overflow.
findings.evidence: screenshots/contact-mobile.png and screenshots/contact-mobile-full.png; browser measurement document.scrollWidth=390 and clientWidth=390
findings.user_impact: The recruiter can continue by scrolling, but the persistent dock temporarily obscures reading and may hide a focused source or Memory control near the viewport edge.
findings.recommendation: Add bottom scroll padding and focus scroll margins sized to the floating dock plus safe-area inset, then verify anchored and keyboard-focused content clears the dock.
findings.verification: At 320, 390, and 430 CSS pixels, tab or activate every contact and Memory control; the focused element and its label must remain fully visible above the dock with no horizontal scrolling.

strengths: The mobile contact page starts with the person and current relationship state; the Agent rail stays hidden until explicitly invoked.
Ask Agent expands the scoped Agent surface, while the dedicated create-contact intent keeps the creation card open.
The 390-pixel runtime had no horizontal overflow, and primary contact actions expand to balanced full-width touch targets.
Empty profile and contact sections are removed rather than rendered as placeholder cards.
missing_evidence: VoiceOver order and announcement evidence for profile provenance, contact source, Memory status, and Agent expansion.
Dynamic Type or browser text-zoom evidence at 200 percent.
Reduced-motion browser capture verifying the full interaction path.
open_questions: Should Memory history remain collapsed on small screens when a recruiter returns specifically from an outcome-review notification?

top_findings.reason: Provenance is preserved in data and shown in UI, but exact per-field source navigation is not yet one step.
top_findings.next_step: Bind each contact point's source label to its exact governed resource.
top_findings.verification: Three contact points from three sources each open only their matching governed source while values remain masked.

top_findings.reason: The safe creation wedge is complete, but recurring optional structured data still needs a governed post-identity enrichment step.
top_findings.next_step: Prototype schema-driven optional enrichment with hidden-empty behavior and separate authored versus sourced provenance.
top_findings.verification: A recruiter creates and enriches a synthetic contact without bypassing identity review or turning authored orientation into evidence.

top_findings.reason: The responsive layout has no horizontal overflow, but the fixed dock can temporarily cover reading or focus context.
top_findings.next_step: Add dock-aware scroll padding and focus margins.
top_findings.verification: All controls remain fully visible when focused at 320, 390, and 430 CSS pixels.

agreements: The record correctly separates stable person identity, relationship-scoped Memory, and interaction history.
The Agent create flow preserves identity checking and human confirmation before persistence.
The contact UI is a useful, quiet CRM slice rather than a document or surveillance vault.
adjudication.rationale: No active safety veto was found. The frozen runtime proves the core directory, contact, Memory, and Agent creation loop works with masked, authorized data and responsive behavior. The remaining findings are bounded improvements rather than release blockers.

next_tests.test: Run five timed recruiter tasks across lookup, creation, enrichment, and return-to-context.
next_tests.evidence_required: Screen recordings, completion time, correction count, and post-task confidence from independent recruiters.
next_tests.pass_condition: At least four of five participants complete every core task without identity ambiguity or asking where the current relationship state lives.

next_tests.test: Add exact contact-point source navigation and test authorization revocation while the record is open.
next_tests.evidence_required: Automated integration test plus runtime recording before and after revocation.
next_tests.pass_condition: The exact source opens when authorized and the contact hint disappears without raw-value leakage after revocation.

next_tests.test: Run dock-clearance, keyboard focus, 200 percent zoom, and screen-reader order checks at small breakpoints.
next_tests.evidence_required: Browser recordings and accessibility-tree snapshots at 320, 390, and 430 CSS pixels.
next_tests.pass_condition: No focused or read-critical element is obscured, clipped, or announced out of decision order.
